_comment: Illustration de l'app iOS pour la carte « Invite un ami » (fil d'accueil et profil), direction affiche (mêmes réglages que manifest-app-progress.json) : marine et safran sur papier crème. Sortie convertie en JPEG 1200 × 900 dans ios/Sophia/Assets.xcassets/invite_poster.imageset. Le modèle ne respecte pas toujours le fond crème : relancer si besoin.

items.name: invite_a
items.prompt: On a plain cream paper background: two simple friendly figures, one deep navy blue and one saffron yellow, facing each other, one handing a big wrapped gift box with a ribbon to the other; three small open books float above them like presents, with a few small four-point stars. Flat poster illustration, linocut paper-cut shapes, strictly two colors: deep navy blue and saffron yellow on a cream paper background, bold simple forms, subtle paper grain, airy composition, lots of empty cream space, no text, no letters, no numbers, no outlines.
